# Coverage ledger (generated by `tools/ledger.py` - do not edit)

Keyed by the function address of the Hex-Rays export `data/x2.exe.c` (`//----- (ADDR)` markers). The rules live in `docs/ledger.tsv` (embedded LuaJIT) and `docs/ledger-classes.tsv` (C++ engine); update them when porting.

The export contains **33294** functions: **1172** belong to the embedded LuaJIT 2.0.2 / C runtime (by name), **26233** are methods of **2879** C++ classes, the rest are free functions / CRT.

## Embedded LuaJIT 2.0.2 runtime

| status | functions |
|---|---|
| done | 162 |
| partial | 112 |
| stub | 17 |
| n/a | 879 |
| todo | 2 |

Deliberately not ported (`n/a`): the JIT compiler and its IR/assembler (the VM is an interpreter, which LuaJIT guarantees to be semantically equivalent; nothing in the client reads `jit.*`), the FFI (flag 0 in all 4,498 scripts), the garbage collector and allocator (JS GC), and the C API used by the engine's own bindings (replaced by the host API of phase 5).
